notes.title: Patch 0.25.1.0.EA
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 0.25.1.0.EA – Rise of Balance [/h1][hr][/hr][h3]MECHANICS – The Rules Evolve[/h3][p]
-Once, your decks held 20 Creatures and 20 Equipment.[/p][p]Now, the challenges expands: you will have 30 Creatures and 30 Equipment, forging strategies across every rarity.[/p][p]Five cards each rarity — from Common to Legendary.[/p][p]
-The Elemental Shields, once bound to protect only your own, have broken their chains.[/p][p]They can now target enemy creatures in hand, piercing plans before they unfold.[/p][p]
-The age of duplicates is ending:[/p][p]From this day forth, you may carry only one copy of each card, regardless of rarity.[/p][p]Precision and uniqueness shall reign.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]RANK SYSTEM – Challenge TOP 100[/h3][p][/p][p]-No longer are you confined to skirmishes near your own Rank.[/p][p]All ranks now collide in Ranked Battles — bronze may face gold, iron may rise to strike platinum, and even the humble Wood may challenge the might of Masters.[/p][p]And if you dare face a foe two or more ranks above, the Gods of Dutemtor shall reward your courage with bonus rank points — while your unfortunate opponent may suffer a hard fall.[/p][p]
-Once, only the Masters' names were known to the Gods of Dutemtor.[/p][p]Now, all heroes who reach the TOP 100 shall be engraved in the stars.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]GRAPHICS – A New Light Rises[/h3][p]
-The world of Temperia has been bathed in new light.[/p][p]From the softest shadows to the gleam of enchanted steel, every detail shines anew.[/p][p]Open your eyes — and behold the realm as never before.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]OTHER FEATURES – Fortune and Destiny[/h3][p][/p][p]-The Wheel of Fortune has appeared. Spin it daily — and let fate guide your rewards...[/p][p]but beware the mysterious Three Suktar.[/p][p]
-In the Clone Card Quest, you can now see which cards are needed to unlock each Avatar.[/p][p]Destiny, made visible.[/p][p]
-The tutorial has a new face: Maximus himself now guides you through the world and mechanics of Temperia.[/p][p]
-Does your friend have a better deck than you? Convinced them to share it?[/p][p]No problem! You can now export and import decks — and don’t worry,[/p][p]Temperia will inform you of any missing cards.[/p]

notes.title: New Patch v 0.11.29.1.EA - NEW DECK CARD LIMITS, SKILL BALANCE
notes.content:
Dear Players,

New big update is live! Here list of changes


- New deck limits (Rare minimum 4, before 3) (Epic maximum 4, before 3)
- Skills balance (all new features)
- Ratzur is now Ratalas (name change)
- Popup(which card missing) and possibility to save incomplete deck
- EQ blocked in 1 round also with chains
- Earth effect is now visible in preview mode during Gameplay. It's hiding all values of card.
- New look of Mage Academy Skin (with changed creature name) 
- Fixed issue with possibility of switch card with Void card (after using void on another card) 

Balance changes: 

Skills:
ARMOR
Before : 1 shield on 1 value
Now : Has 2 Shields that ignores 1 of attacking values

EVOC
Before : placing -1 to one free slot (without card or evoc on it)
Now : When you play it on the board give to empty slots 2 times a -1 on 2 sides

KARMA
Before : gives you +1 every turn if karma card is in your hand
Now : If it is in hand, at the end of your first 2 rounds it gets a +1 on a random value

SPARK
Before : Shoots spark to card in enemy hand and gives -1 on one value
Now : When you play it on the Board Shoot 2 times a -1 on a creature in the opponent's hand

BRAVE
Before : When you place creature on the board, it gives +2 to a random value of another creature of your color
Now : When you play it on the board, it gives +2 and +1 on a creature of yours color. If There is no others creature with your vcolor, BRAVE card get +1.

FEAR
Before : When you place this creature on the board, it deducts -1 from a random  value  of a random opponent`s Creature Card on the board.
Now : When you play it on the board give 2 times a -1 on to an opposing creatures on the board

ASPIR
Before : When you place this creature on the board, it gives +1 to a random value of a creature and deducts -1 from a random value of another creature in your hand
After : When you play it on Board, give a -1 from a creature in your hand and get +2 on a Value.

Best,
Temperia Dev Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41504677/bc52c58efe7d20e3216b3b5bad4ec4b1cdaadfb5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New patch! PATCH 0.11.28.1.EA - Balance + Clone card fix + New resolutions
notes.content:
Here are some of the changes done in the current patch with QoL improvements and balance changes.
Please remember we are still working to improve the game, so expect more patches and fixes soon.
1. The Wurgen Avatar is now changed to correspond to the new look.
2. Added brand new, dark, and aggressive-looking Animated Icon of Jack Norgrave to the Shop.
3. We have changed Clone Card behavior. Now you can finish the clone card mission only via the main menu; you also can clone all five cards from the opponent's hand.
4. We have improved support for more variety of display resolutions.
5. In building deck view, we added the possibility to save decks that do not meet minimal requirements. Now, the requirements are checked before Match. So you can store the uncompleted deck and finish it later.
6. In order to balance the gameplay, the Red player is now prohibited from playing the EQ card in the first round. This should add an extra advantage to the Blue player.
7. Opening more than one pack at once has been removed. It will be reworked in the future.8. Improved stability of connection during Mulligan phase and drawing cards.
Best,

Temperia Dev Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41504677/f4f69c0d28e57fb5ff72a3d6ab9fb848751d3881.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.11.20.EA - New daily missions!
notes.content:
We are now applying the new patch, you can take a look at what is going to be changed.

Today's patch notes introduce some balance changes:
1. Ratzur common creature now gets Spark skill.
2. Adrembug uncommon creature gets Fear skill.
3. Tuohsaw epic creature now loses Fire element.

Also, in order to make it easier to get new cards, we are introducing some changes to the economy:
4. Now everyone has the additional daily quest to win 0/3 and later 0/5 and finally 0/10 games (they do not need to be in a row). The first and second quest gives you 1x pack of cards as a reward, and the third one gives you 3x pack of cards as a reward.
5. Each player now gets eight random quests each day.
6. We have removed all quests with casting Equipment cards with specific elements with goal 3+.
7. There are new level prizes with more packs, zdl and dust! 

There are also some fixes to bugs:
8. Sometimes Light Elemental Power was adding or subtracting wrong values with connection to Equipment cards.
9. Some of you encountered a huge number of LOST CONNECTION situations. We fixed the problem when it was done by the desynch of a client with the server.

We are still investigating the issue when some players can not connect to the matchmaking (remember, DC before you will see the cards does not subtract your league points) or lose connection without desynchronization. 

EXTRA REWARD
In order to thank you for your patience and HUGE support, we are granting to each player 5x packs of cards. We hope you will find good cards inside! 

BEST OF LUCK!!!
Temperia Dev Team

notes.title: Patch online 0.11.17.EA
notes.content:
Hi all! 🤗 Thank you very much for all bug reports. We are constantly checking the issues and working on them. Here is the list of all changes that we have done so far! Please bear in mind that we are constantly working on improving the game! 

===== 0.11.17.EA HOTFIX =====

1. New behavior of light elemental power:

    a) LIGHT elemental power can be played on both Player's Hand and the Board. It changes the Power Values of the target card in all directions by +1 or -1.

    b) If the player plays the Light on his own Hand or Board, the effect ends at the end of the current turn.

    c) If the player plays the Light on the Opponent Hand, the effect ends on the following opponent's turn.

2. Small rebalance of creature cards:
    a) Updated skills on Khornauran (before was ASPIR, now KARMA),
    b) and Bill ROSKON (before was ARMOR, now BRAVE).

3. Upgraded Jim Warok avatar, that corresponds to card look

4. Streamer mode fix: Now there is no need to set the streamer mode every time. The one-time setting will be kept until turned off

5. Fix in ranked point system: Now it is not possible to drop your rank points below the lower rank limit from which you cannot be demotioned

6. Fix the crafting issue of Otar: Fixed an issue that prevented from crafting of the Otar creature card in the cards menu and displayed the message "Wrong prize"

7. Connection error during the matchmaking (temporary fix): Any disconnection of a match before moving to the playfield and displaying cards will now result in the entire match being cancelled and no rewards will be given.

We are still investigating the situation where some players are not able to connect to the game during the matchmaking. We are aware of that issue, and we are working hard to resolve it. Thank you for your patience.

8. Changes in shop: The order of tabs in the shop window has been changed. Early Access packs are now first, and we have removed the featured tab

9. Gameplay double move error: Fixed an issue with possibility to play second card on the board at the end of the turn

10. Logging to the game issue: Now the game will remember your window mode (fullscreen, borderless, window), even after restart.

We know that some of you have other issues, and we hear you! We are working hard to solve all the technical difficulties and we will update you ASAP! Thank you for being with us, and have a great time playing Temperia! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41504677/0a80ec19306dc0834e0d3a62dcc7853f8f5d4cd1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: TEMPERIA: SOUL OF MAJESTIC, CLOSED BETA HOTFIX - D1
notes.content:
Dear [b]Temperia: Soul of Majestic [/b]players!

We are all delighted that you have joined closed BETA in the last few hours! All your feedback is heard, and we are working hard to improve the game each day. Thank you for your help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41504677/c7207cf49fa2a3d175a2ade91dc5468d2ac77e9a.png[/img]

Here, we are sharing some of the essential updates and improvements from Day 1:

- Improvements in ranked matchmaking. Now players with a rank difference of one can play against each other 
- Gameplay ranks are now shown in gameplay 
- Improvements in handling disconnections. The disconnect is now equal to surrendering the game 
- Updated the chance of getting epic, mythical, legendary cards in packs 
- Minor fixes in the Main Menu 
- Added a requirement to watch all tutorials before the first game - Improvement of the elemental power of Air 
- Only aspect ratio compatible with monitor available to set in settings

Thank you again, and we hope you will enjoy Temperia gameplay!

The current build number is [b]0.8.4 [/b]BETA.
